_comment: One entry per map texture the game ships (from DT_WorldMapUIData landScapeRealPositionMin/Max). Read by scripts/slice_map.py, scripts/datagen/generate_map_objects.py, scripts/datagen/validate.py, the API (/api/game-data) and the frontend (frontend/js/utils.js). Bounds are world coordinates; every span is square and matches the square 8192px texture. Never hand-fit these.
